content.title: 2026 Masters streaming schedule: How to watch the Augusta action online
content.text: The 2026 Masters features arguably the most expansive streaming coverage of any tournament. Hector Vivas/Getty Images This week’s 2026 Masters at Augusta National features the best golfers on Earth fighting for a huge purse and major history. And you can catch every shot of the entire event online. Here’s all the information you need to watch the Masters streaming live online.How to stream Masters onlineWhile the Masters TV coverage is somehwat limited compared to other major championships, the same is not true of the Masters streaming coverage. No other tournament boasts such extensive online viewing options. And they’ve expanded again this year.Via Masters.com, the Masters app, the ESPN App, Amazon Prime Video, Paramount+ and DirecTV, golf fans will have virtually endless ways to stream the Masters. How Augusta National gets put to bed each night of the Masters By: Sean Zak Prime Video will provide exclusive early coverage of the first and second rounds, with coverage kicking of at 1 p.m. ET on Thursday and Friday. Paramount+ will provide similar early coverage of Saturday’s third round and Friday’s second round.All of that coverage and more will be available for free on Masters.com and the Masters App. There, you can also view every shot hit by each competitor. Featured group coverage and multiple featured hole streams will be available on an array of platforms, including all-day Amen Corner coverage.Masters.com, the Masters App and the ESPN app will also
